nodes.title: When you've selected which Sample Preview to upscale, enable the below toggle\nthen continue right ->

Start your upscale by clicking the below button. If you don't like the result, you can reroll\nby clicking the button as many times as you like to get variations of the first pass! (Unless\nyou change something like prompt, resolution, refs, ANYTHING that happened before this step)
Start new gens by making sure 'Enable Final Pass' is\nturned off then click Manual Random Seed button below
After the First Pass Sample Previews all finish, select which of\nthe 3 looks best below. Then continue right ->
The int8 video VAE by Kijai (in the list below) is highly\nrecommended! Lots of encoding/decoding with this model/wf so... speed is of the essence!
Don't worry if RIFE or Final Video have a red outline, it just means\nthere's no output going there on this run. It's a big fake scary 'error' but doesn't prevent anything.

Disable all but the first Stage 1 Sampler Preview and it will automatically
proceed to finalization. Makes the WF function like a normal 1-pass workflow.
Make sure "Upscale Pass" is turned off!
Note: CANNOT be used with VIDEO CONTINUATION

.: V2V Editing (replace a character in a target video) --- NOTE: TENDS TO LOOK BETTER ON SINGLE PASS. SEE OPTION ABOVE ---

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the girl whose motion comes from <Video 1> and whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>.
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The girl's appearance is styled from <Picture 1>. Her motion, camera movement, background, and lighting from the video are preserved continuously from start to finish without deviation at any point.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the girl's face, body proportions, and skin tone from <Picture 1> are retained, and her motion, choreography, rhythm, and timing from <Video 1> are retained at every moment. 
<Video 1> (whole-video temporal structure, motion path, camera movement, background, lighting): fully_preserved - the girl's choreography, movement speed, gestures, body positions, camera framing, camera movement, background, and lighting from every frame of <Video 1> are preserved throughout the entire target video without deviation.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a naturalistic style matching the source footage, preserving its original lighting, color grading, and camera work.
[Shot 1] The camera follows <Subject 1>, the girl, as she exists in the same setting from <Video 1>. Her appearance matches <Picture 1> — same skin tone, body shape, and natural contours. Throughout the entire video, her motion is a frame-by-frame motion match to <Video 1>: the same choreography, gestures, limb positions, movement speed, and rhythm are followed continuously from start to finish. The camera framing, angle, and movement stay locked to <Video 1> at all times. The background remains identical and unchanged.


.: Reference Generation (general filmmaking):

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the character in <Picture 1>. (basic description)

<Subject 2> is the scene location in <Picture 2>. (basic scene description)

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] highly realistic live-action scene of <Subject 1> in <Subject 2>.

retention_analysis:
<Audio 1>: reference - its vocal timbre guides the vocal delivery of <Subject 1> without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]: a close up shot of <Subject 1> with a shocked expression as the camera pulls in towards her face. Suddenly, she turns around to look behind her.
[Shot 2]: a 3/4ths shot of <Subject 1> as she turns, her expression is confused. She tilts her head to one side, a look of questioning. She hesitantly says using <Audio 1> as her vocal-timbre reference: <d>[English]Hello?.. Is anyone there?</d> her tone is hesitant and suspicious.
[Shot 3]: an over-the-shoulder following shot as <Subject 1> begins to walk through <Subject 2> looking around side to side.
 
overall_soundscape:
interior ambience.

N/A

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: the woman with long black hair and a purple bikini top, appearing in Picture 1, Picture 3, Picture 4, and Picture 5. She wears gold earrings and a necklace; her expression shifts from contemplative to intense.
<Subject 2>: the blonde man with a muscular build, wearing a brown belt and necklace, appearing in Picture 2, Picture 3, Picture 4, and Picture 5.
<Picture 1>: frames the woman standing beside the man against a cloudy sky; anchors Shot 1.
<Picture 2>: frames the man holding a spear in a dark jungle setting; anchors Shot 2.
<Picture 3>: frames both characters together under starry night skies; anchors Shot 4.
<Picture 4>: frames the woman looking up at the man with a soft expression; anchors Shot 5.
<Picture 5>: frames the couple standing side-by-side in daylight; anchors Shot 6.
<Video 1>: serves as visual reference for overall composition, lighting, and character style — not tied to specific shot timing.

summary: keyframe completion + video continuation + audio reuse

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): attribute_transfer - her attire, jewelry, hair, and emotional expressions are preserved across shots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): attribute_transfer — his physique, accessories, expression, and positioning remain consistent with reference imagery.
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved — used as the starting visual anchor for Shot 1.
<Picture 2>: partially_preserved — provides posture and lighting reference for Shot 2 but not full frame match.
<Picture 3>: fully_preserved — anchors Shot 4’s intimate framing.
<Picture 4>: weak_reference — references emotional tone in Shot 5, but composition varies.
<Picture 5>: fully_preserved — anchors Shot 6’s establishing shot.

detailed_description: The video is rendered in a live-action cinematic style with naturalistic lighting and soft focus transitions.

 [Shot 1] begins from Picture 1, framing the woman (S1) standing beside the man under a cloudy sky; she wears her purple bikini top and gold jewelry. A jungle clearing surrounds them, dappled with sunlight filtering through dense trees. The camera holds static as the woman turns toward him, her expression calm but knowing.

 [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera pushes in slowly at slow speed toward the man (S2) standing alone under a moonlit canopy; he grips his spear tightly, his face stern and resolute — referencing Picture 2’s posture and lighting. The jungle soundscape is layered with distant animal calls and rustling leaves. 

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of both characters side-by-side under starry skies; the man places his hand on her shoulder as she looks up at him — referencing Picture 3’s framing. The woman (S1) whispers softly: [English] “I spent a week at 2389 building order approvals.” <scenetrans> The dialogue continues seamlessly across the cut. 

[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera tilts up slightly to follow their gaze as they look toward a distant horizon; referencing Picture 3’s emotional tone but repositioning them for dramatic effect. They remain still, silent, under the stars — no dialogue.

 [Shot 5] At 00:10.500, the shot pulls back to show them standing side-by-side in daylight — referencing Picture 4’s framing and their proximity. The woman (S1) turns slightly toward him, her lips parted; she does not speak. 

[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the camera cuts to a tight close-up of the man’s face as he looks down at her — referencing Picture 5’s emotional connection but reframing for intimacy. He says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>Agentic application delivery is here.</d> while his lips remain completely closed. The scene ends on this shot.

overall_soundscape: Ambient jungle sounds dominate — rustling leaves, distant birdsong, and soft wind through tall grasses. A low hum of insects adds texture to the background. No dialogue or music in this segment except for the voiceover.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

https://github.com/obvpm/comfyui-obvpm (must be manually installed, unzipped folder into /custom_nodes/)

.: Latent Upscaler
- Node: https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
- Latent Upscale Model: https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors
(put into /latent_upscale_models/ folder)

.: Sol-Attention (Speedup, works best at higher step counts 12+)
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton

.: Turbo LoRA
https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/blob/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
Lightx2v's recommendation is to use euler/beta, with shift value 6.0/3.0

.: Audio/Video Loader node
https://github.com/WhatDreamsCost/WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI

.: TaeH3 (for Kijai's Model Preview Override):
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors

.: Kijai's int8 Video VAE (much faster than default!)
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors

Everything else should be easily available from the ComfyUI-manager Install Missing Nodes screen!

-------------------------------

Download the Node-pack zip files and extract into:
ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\ folder.

Or if you have git installed, go into custom_nodes folder and open CMD prompt and type:
git clone [url]
